_note: Ranges measured 29 Oct 2026 with voice_style.py. natural = the faceless-channel study's 7 videos from 2024-2026 (I01-I04, I07-I09; its 2023 videos I05/I06 were flatter). format = the shorts-format study's pace with natural-level life. format-long = the shorts-format study's long videos. Each entry: [low, high, what to do if it fails]. format-real (11 Nov 2026) = the real ranges of the format benchmark's 10 top Shorts, not the livelier 'format' set: one calm storyteller, long sentences, very few stops, even loudness.

speed_wps: Too slow: tighten joins and speed up 3-6 % with pitch kept. Too fast: add || holds on key points.
phrase_speed_variation_pct: Too even: comp phrases from different takes, add a slow [pause]d line before reveals and a fast aside.
tone_swing_semitones: Monotone: add tone tags where the mood changes, "!" and "...", then re-comp from the liveliest takes.
stressed_words_per_min: Flat stress: one CAPS word in more sentences. Too much: remove CAPS from minor words.
long_pauses_per_min: Add || holds after reveals, punchlines and key points (or remove some if it drags).
mid_pauses_per_min: Use commas and "..." inside sentences for small breaths.
fillers_per_min: Write in a few conversational words (look, I mean, okay so, wait) where a person would say them.
loudness_swing_db: Too even: add a whispered or softly line and an excited line; avoid heavy compression before the check.

speed_wps: The format pace is about 2.8-3.0 words a second: cut words, or slow the read with [slowly] on one line.
phrase_speed_variation_pct: Comp phrases from different takes for natural variation.
tone_swing_semitones: Monotone: re-comp from the liveliest takes; one tone tag at the start; CAPS on the key word.
stressed_words_per_min: Too few: one CAPS stress word per batch. Too many: remove CAPS and "!" from minor words.
long_pauses_per_min: The format benchmark never pauses: remove || holds and "..."; tighten joins to 0.1 s.
mid_pauses_per_min: Remove commas that create breaks; tighten joins.
fillers_per_min: The format benchmark uses no fillers: remove them (note: common words like "so" and "like" also count here).

speed_wps: The format benchmark's long-video pace is about 2.8 words a second.
phrase_speed_variation_pct: Comp phrases from different takes; slow down before reveals.
tone_swing_semitones: Monotone: re-comp from the liveliest takes; tags where the mood changes.
stressed_words_per_min: Too few: one CAPS stress word in more sentences. Too many: remove CAPS from minor words.
long_pauses_per_min: Holds only where the edit has a music drop or black beat.
mid_pauses_per_min: Use commas and "..." inside sentences for small breaths.
fillers_per_min: The format benchmark uses almost no fillers: remove them.
loudness_swing_db: Add a softer line in tense moments.

speed_wps: The format benchmark speaks at about 2.7-3.0 words a second: slow the take (pitch kept) or cut words.
phrase_speed_variation_pct: Too uneven: use one take per piece, do not comp phrase by phrase.
tone_swing_semitones: Mood swings too much: one calm tag for the whole read, no mood changes between pieces.
stressed_words_per_min: Too punchy: remove CAPS and "!"; join fragments into flowing sentences.
long_pauses_per_min: The format benchmark never pauses a second: cap every gap at 0.3 s.
mid_pauses_per_min: No half-second pauses: cap every gap at 0.3 s; remove commas that make breaks.
short_pauses_per_min: Too many small stops: fewer full stops and commas (his sentences run 14-25 words).
stops_per_min: Too many stops (his Shorts: about 10 a minute): write flowing sentences, tighten the joins.
loudness_swing_db: Loudness too uneven: compress the voice until phrases sit within about 1-2 dB.
